info.description: Headquarters API for master menu governance, outlet assignment, API keys, sync ingestion and cross-outlet reporting. All responses use the `ApiSuccess`/`ApiError` envelopes; money is a decimal string of integer minor units.

roleCodes.description: Replaces the role set when present.

catalogRevision.description: Catalog revision, decimal string of bigint.

defaultPriceMinor.description: Integer minor units, decimal string of bigint.

version.description: Bumped on every edit; echoed to outlets.

defaultPriceMinor.description: Default price in integer minor units, decimal string of bigint.
Integer minor units, decimal string of bigint.

priceOverrideMinor.description: Per-outlet price override in integer minor units (decimal string of bigint). Send null to clear and fall back to the master default.
Override price, minor units; null when using the default.

catalogRevision.description: Catalog revision generated, decimal string of bigint.

active.description: Assignment active flag (effective only while item ACTIVE).

expiresInHours.description: Optional expiry in hours; omit for a non-expiring key.

scopes.description: Scopes; defaults to all three sync scopes.

secret.description: Raw 256-bit secret. Shown exactly once; store it securely now.

graceHours.description: Overlap window for the predecessor key, hours.

unitPriceMinor.description: Effective outlet price — minor units, decimal string.

item.description: Full effective item snapshot for UPSERT; null for REMOVE tombstones.

fromRevision.description: The afterRevision this page starts from — decimal string.

nextRevision.description: Revision after applying this page (checkpoint target) — decimal string.

headRevision.description: Outlet's current head revision — decimal string.

hasMore.description: True when more changes exist beyond this page.

snapshotRequired.description: True when contiguous history is unavailable; the outlet must take a snapshot.

unitPriceMinor.description: Effective outlet price — minor units, decimal string.

active.description: False marks the tombstone: the outlet deactivates the item locally.

snapshotRevision.description: Revision of the snapshot view — decimal string.

eventId.description: Equals the outlet outbox row ID.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version; HQ supports 1 and rejects others per event.

retryable.description: True when the outlet should retry this event unchanged.

acknowledgedAt.description: Present for terminal successes (ACCEPTED, DUPLICATE); null otherwise.

detail.description: Stable reason code for non-success outcomes (e.g. UNSUPPORTED_EVENT_VERSION, EVENT_ID_CONFLICT).

highestContiguousSequence.description: Highest contiguous accepted sequence for the outlet — decimal string.

reason.description: Failure reason when the check is down.
